$comment: Hand-written at adoption on 2026-11-10 because `nen shu detect` answered `no lane detected`; re-declared on 2026-11-11 when issue #1 moved the site from a Python generator to Gatsby + TypeScript + Chakra UI (zheref/swift-cheatsheets#1). The `dependency` block carries the fields of Hatsu's own contract this repository reads, plus the bootstrap script's and the binary's sha256 for any reader that verifies against trusted content (none here yet: zheref/hatsu#247), all at Hatsu's pinned build; it moves only at a repin. Repinned on 2026-11-16 from v0.21.0 to v0.30.0, because nen 0.30's compatibility floor refuses any minimum under 0.30. The `project` block declares exactly what package.json runs. On the `site` lane every verb the repository does not have is an explicit seat with its reason; the focused lanes beside it declare `test` only, as Hatsu's own focused lanes do, and every other verb is `site`'s.

sha256.$comment: Release digests of the pinned binary, copied from Hatsu's contract and checked on 2026-11-16 against the v0.30.0 release's SHA256SUMS (all three) and the bootstrapped darwin-arm64 binary. They move with the pin.

site-ui.$comment: Focused lane for the Bankai primitives and the page built on them: a change under src/bankai/** or src/ui/**. Its test row runs the seven test files that import src/bankai or src/ui (adapters, accessibility, bankai, catalogs, languages, parity, render); parity holds the only assertion of src/ui/cards' isWide and adapters the only one of src/ui/theme's themeInitScript. Kokusen's focused checkpoint for that behaviour, never the regression suite: the whole suite and its coverage stay the `site` lane's, run at mukai.

site-content.$comment: Focused lane for the content model: a change under src/content/** or content/** (the catalogs, the loader, search, highlighting, language switching). Every test file imports src/content, eight directly and all ten through test/helpers.ts, and examples reads the real content/languages, so this row runs all ten files — the whole suite without --coverage, because there is no narrower honest set. Not the regression run: that, with its coverage, stays `site`'s at mukai.

site-adapters.$comment: Focused lane for the two adapters and the Gatsby entry points: a change under src/adapters/**, src/pages/** or gatsby-*.ts[x]. Its test row runs adapters (both adapters, the 404 page, the offline file), accessibility (which reads src/pages' source) and languages (the offline paths the selector links to). Not the regression suite: `site` runs every file at mukai.

site-scripts.$comment: Focused lane for scripts/serve.mts, scripts/verify.mts and scripts/run-examples.mts: its test row runs scripts (serve and verify) and examples (run-examples). scripts/build-offline.mts, scripts/readiness_ci_verdict.mts and scripts/consumer_trailer_ci.mts have no test file yet, so a change to them has no focused route here and is reported as such, never sent to this lane. Not the regression suite: `site` runs every file at mukai.

build.$comment: Gatsby production build into public/, then the offline single-file export written to the committed index.html.

lint.$comment: tsc --noEmit, then scripts/verify.mts's structural checks on both built pages; runs after `build` in iteration.checks.

test.$comment: The whole suite (a few seconds): content and anchor parity with the pre-migration page, highlighter and search parity, loader refusals, static render + hydration, both adapters, the offline file from disk. Writes the lcov capture the coverage row reads. `--no --` makes npx refuse to fetch vitest from the registry when node_modules is absent (run `npm ci` first), instead of installing an unpinned one.

coverage.$comment: Extraction only: the test row wrote coverage/lcov.info (v8 provider, src/** and gatsby-*.ts[x]); this row runs nothing (byakugan section 3).

ui-test.unsupported: No browser end-to-end suite; rendering, hydration and interaction are exercised in jsdom by the test row, and the built pages by `lint`.

archive.unsupported: The distributable is the committed offline index.html that `build` regenerates; no separate archive step exists.

run.unsupported: There is no production start: the site is served from public/ by `dev`, or the offline file is opened directly.

deploy.unsupported: No deploy destination has been chosen; the site is served locally over the LAN.

release.unsupported: No publication destination has been chosen; nothing here publishes a release.

test.$comment: The files that import src/bankai or src/ui. No --coverage: a focused run measures nothing, and writes no capture over the `site` lane's. `--no --`: never fetch vitest from the registry.
All ten files, named: every one imports src/content (test/helpers.ts). No --coverage. `--no --`: never fetch vitest from the registry.
The files that import src/adapters, read src/pages, or use the offline paths. No --coverage. `--no --`: never fetch vitest from the registry.
The files that import scripts/serve.mts, scripts/verify.mts and scripts/run-examples.mts. No --coverage. `--no --`: never fetch vitest from the registry.

node.why: Gatsby 5.16 supports Node 18-25 (package.json engines caps it below 26); jsdom 31 and vitest 5 need 22.22+ on the 22 line or 24.15+ on the 24 line (package.json engines: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0; nen reads a floor only). .nvmrc pins 24. nen never installs a host toolchain.
